page.title: 過去分詞で背景を先に描く

analysis.summaryJa: 文頭の過去分詞句は「〜されて」「〜した状態なので」という背景を簡潔に先出しし、その意味上の主語は原則として主節の主語と一致する。一方、「〜されること」という出来事自体を主語・目的語にするには裸の過去分詞ではなくbeing＋過去分詞が必要である。画像の背景雲とBEINGカプセルを根拠に両用法を分ける。
grammarPoints: 文頭の過去分詞句は主節主語の受動状態・理由・条件などを示す
分詞句の意味上の主語と主節主語を一致させる
過去分詞句の後ろには通常カンマを置く
受動の出来事を名詞化するにはbeing＋過去分詞を使う
前置詞や動詞の目的語にもbeing＋過去分詞を置ける
visualEvidence: 過去分詞の背景雲から主節の主語へ矢印が伸びる
Built beside the lakeとSurrounded by fogが背景の先出しとして示される
being＋過去分詞の緑のカプセルが名詞の席に入る
Rejected is disappointingが誤り、Being rejected ...が正解として対比される
commonTraps: 分詞句の意味上の主語と主節主語をずらす
裸の過去分詞をそのまま主語として使う
受動の意味なのにbeingの後ろを現在分詞にする
文頭分詞句と主節の間のカンマを落とす

questions.prompt: ------- near the airport, the hotel is convenient for business travelers.
questions.translationJa: 空港近くに位置しているため、そのホテルは出張者に便利です。
questions.explanationJa: hotelが「位置させられた」状態を背景にする過去分詞Locatedを使います。
questions.focus: 文頭過去分詞句と主語一致

questions.prompt: ------- by a security code, the archive is inaccessible to visitors.
questions.translationJa: セキュリティコードで保護されているため、その資料庫には来訪者は入れません。
questions.explanationJa: archiveが保護される受動状態をProtected by ...で先に示します。

questions.prompt: ------- in three languages, the instructions are easy to follow.
questions.translationJa: 3言語で書かれているので、その説明書は分かりやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: 主節主語instructionsが書かれたものなので過去分詞Writtenが一致します。

questions.prompt: ------- during the storm, the outdoor event was moved indoors.
questions.translationJa: 嵐の間に中止されたため、屋外行事は屋内へ移されました。
questions.explanationJa: eventが中止されたという受動背景をCanceledで表します。

questions.prompt: Being ------- without an appointment can be frustrating for customers.
questions.translationJa: 予約がないため待たされることは顧客にとっていら立たしい場合があります。
questions.explanationJa: 受動の出来事を主語にするためBeing kept waitingという名詞相当のまとまりにします。

questions.prompt: The applicant appreciated being ------- promptly about the decision.
questions.translationJa: 応募者は決定についてすぐに通知されたことに感謝しました。
questions.explanationJa: appreciateの目的語として受動の出来事をbeing notifiedで表します。

questions.prompt: Employees are concerned about being ------- by the new scheduling system.
questions.translationJa: 従業員は新しい勤務表システムで混乱させられることを懸念しています。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞aboutの後ろに受動動名詞being confusedを置きます。

questions.prompt: ------- from recycled materials, the packaging has a smaller environmental impact.
questions.translationJa: 再生材料で作られているので、その梱包材は環境負荷が小さくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: packagingが材料から作られた受動状態をMade from ...で示します。

questions.prompt: ------- with all required receipts, the expense claim was approved immediately.
questions.translationJa: 必要な領収書をすべて添えて提出されたため、その経費申請はすぐ承認されました。
questions.explanationJa: claimが提出された受動背景をSubmitted with ...で表します。
questions.focus: 過去分詞句の原因背景

questions.prompt: The consultant dislikes being ------- during client meetings.
questions.translationJa: そのコンサルタントは顧客会議中に話を遮られるのを嫌います。
questions.explanationJa: dislikeの目的語に受動の出来事being interruptedを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a matching understood subject.

choices.A: Designed for small offices, customers require little software training.
choices.B: Designing for small offices, the software was a passive product.
choices.C: Was designed for small offices, the software requires little training.
choices.D: Designed for small offices, the software requires little training.

questions.translationJa: 小規模オフィス向けに設計されているので、そのソフトウェアは研修がほとんど不要です。
questions.explanationJa: Designedの意味上の主語と主節主語the softwareが一致します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence nominalizing a passive event.

choices.A: Selected for the program was an honor.
choices.B: Being selected for the program was an honor.
choices.C: Being selecting for the program was an honor.
choices.D: Was selected for the program was an honor.

questions.translationJa: そのプログラムに選ばれたことは名誉でした。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事を主語にするにはBeing selectedという名詞相当のまとまりが必要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct introductory participle construction.

choices.A: Surrounded by scaffolding, visitors can still enter the building.
choices.B: The building surrounded by scaffolding, remains open it.
choices.C: Surrounded by scaffolding, the building remains open.
choices.D: Being surround by scaffolding, the building remains open.

questions.translationJa: 足場に囲まれていますが、その建物は営業を続けています。
questions.explanationJa: Surroundedの意味上の主語は直後のthe buildingで一致しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after the preposition “without.”

choices.A: The form was processed without being signed by a supervisor.
choices.B: The form was processed without signed by a supervisor.
choices.C: The form was processed without being signing by a supervisor.
choices.D: The form was processed without was signed by a supervisor.

questions.translationJa: その書類は上司の署名がないまま処理されました。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞withoutの後ろに受動動名詞being signedを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing a background reason.

choices.A: Delayed by heavy traffic, the driver called the delivery.
choices.B: Delaying by heavy traffic, the delivery arrived after noon.
choices.C: Was delayed by heavy traffic, the delivery arrived after noon.
choices.D: Delayed by heavy traffic, the delivery arrived after noon.

questions.translationJa: 激しい渋滞で遅れたため、配送品は正午過ぎに届きました。
questions.explanationJa: deliveryが遅れたという背景をDelayed by ...で先出しします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct object after “avoid.”

choices.A: Customers can avoid charged twice by checking the receipt.
choices.B: Customers can avoid being charging twice by checking the receipt.
choices.C: Customers can avoid being charged twice by checking the receipt.
choices.D: Customers can avoid were charged twice by checking the receipt.

questions.translationJa: 顧客はレシートを確認することで二重請求を避けられます。
questions.explanationJa: avoidの目的語には受動動名詞being chargedを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence without a dangling participle.

choices.A: Asked for identification, the guard checked every visitor.
choices.B: Asked for identification, every visitor showed a badge.
choices.C: Asking for identification, every badge was shown.
choices.D: Being ask for identification, every visitor showed a badge.

questions.translationJa: 身分証の提示を求められ、来訪者は全員バッジを見せました。
questions.explanationJa: Askedの意味上の主語every visitorが主節の主語になっています。
questions.focus: 分詞句と行為者の対応

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using “being + past participle” as a subject.

choices.B: Being transferring repeatedly annoyed the caller.
choices.C: Was transferred repeatedly annoyed the caller.
choices.D: Being transferred repeatedly annoyed the caller.

questions.translationJa: 何度も転送されたことが電話相手をいら立たせました。
questions.explanationJa: 受動の出来事全体を主語にするためBeing transferredを用います。
questions.focus: 受動動名詞の主語用法

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal background construction.

choices.A: Equipped with solar panels, the company installed the facility.
choices.B: Equipping with solar panels, the facility uses less electricity.
choices.C: Equipped with solar panels, the facility uses less electricity.
choices.D: Being equip with solar panels, the facility uses less electricity.

questions.translationJa: 太陽光パネルを備えているため、その施設は電力使用量が少なくなっています。
questions.explanationJa: Equippedの主語がthe facilityで一致し、with句も受動状態を補います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct complement after “object to.”

choices.A: The tenants objected to being charged an extra fee.
choices.B: The tenants objected to charged an extra fee.
choices.C: The tenants objected to be charged an extra fee yesterday always.
choices.D: The tenants objected to being charge an extra fee.

questions.translationJa: 入居者は追加料金を請求されることに反対しました。
questions.explanationJa: object toのtoは前置詞なのでbeing chargedという動名詞形を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Located downtown, the branch attracts many walk-in customers.”

choices.A: Because the branch is downtown, it attracts many customers who visit without appointments.
choices.B: The branch attracts customers who locate downtown offices.
choices.D: The branch is difficult to reach from downtown.

questions.translationJa: その支店は中心街にあるため、予約なしの来店客を多く集めます。
questions.explanationJa: Located downtownは主節主語branchの場所を背景理由として示します。
questions.focus: 文頭過去分詞句の理由

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Being praised by a client encouraged the team.”

choices.A: The client required the team to give praise.
choices.B: The team avoided all client comments.
choices.C: The team praised a client and felt encouraged.
choices.D: The fact that a client praised the team encouraged them.

questions.translationJa: 顧客に褒められたことがチームを励ましました。
questions.explanationJa: Being praisedが「褒められること」という受動の出来事を名詞化します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Covered by insurance, the equipment was replaced at no cost.”

choices.A: Insurance was replaced by the equipment.
choices.B: The equipment covered the cost of insurance.
choices.C: Because insurance covered the equipment, it was replaced without charge.
choices.D: The equipment had no insurance coverage.

questions.translationJa: 保険の対象だったため、その機器は無料で交換されました。
questions.explanationJa: Covered by insuranceはequipmentの受動状態と交換理由を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The manager dislikes being interrupted.”

choices.A: The manager enjoys interrupting other people.
choices.B: The manager dislikes it when other people interrupt her.
choices.C: The manager never speaks during meetings.
choices.D: Interruptions are managed by someone else.

questions.translationJa: 部長は他人に話を遮られるのを嫌います。
questions.explanationJa: being interruptedは部長が中断を受ける出来事を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Confused by the two prices, the buyer requested clarification.”

choices.A: Because the buyer was confused by the two prices, the buyer asked for an explanation.
choices.B: The buyer explained both prices clearly.
choices.C: The prices requested clarification from the buyer.
choices.D: The buyer was confident that the prices matched.

questions.translationJa: 2つの価格に戸惑ったため、購入者は説明を求めました。
questions.explanationJa: Confused by ...が主節主語buyerの状態と理由を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We apologized for being delayed.”

choices.A: We apologized before any delay occurred.
choices.B: We apologized because we delayed another person on purpose.
choices.C: We apologized for the fact that something had delayed us.
choices.D: We asked someone else to apologize.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは遅らされたことについて謝罪しました。
questions.explanationJa: being delayedはweが遅延の影響を受けた受動の出来事です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Stored below freezing, the medicine remains effective.”

choices.A: The medicine stores the freezer effectively.
choices.B: The medicine becomes ineffective in cold storage.
choices.C: Someone stores effective freezers near the medicine.
choices.D: Because the medicine is kept below freezing, it remains effective.

questions.translationJa: 氷点下で保管されているので、その薬は効果を保ちます。
questions.explanationJa: Stored below freezingはmedicineの保管状態を背景として示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Being recognized for her work surprised Ms. Cho.”

choices.A: The recognition Ms. Cho received for her work surprised her.
choices.C: Her work surprised the person who recognized it.
choices.D: Ms. Cho recognized someone else’s work.

questions.translationJa: 仕事を評価されたことにチョさんは驚きました。
questions.explanationJa: Being recognizedはチョさんが評価を受けた出来事を主語にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Damaged in transit, the cabinet was returned.”

choices.A: The cabinet damaged another item in transit.
choices.B: The cabinet was returned because it had been damaged during shipping.
choices.C: The cabinet was repaired before any shipment.
choices.D: The return caused the cabinet to be shipped.

questions.translationJa: 輸送中に損傷したため、そのキャビネットは返品されました。
questions.explanationJa: Damaged in transitがcabinetの状態と返品理由を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The vendor denied being informed of the change.”

choices.B: The vendor explained the change to customers.
choices.C: The vendor said that no one had informed it of the change.

questions.translationJa: 業者は変更の連絡を受けたことを否定しました。
questions.explanationJa: being informedはvendorが情報を受けたという受動の出来事です。

questions.prompt: The showroom occupies a renovated factory. ------- with wide aisles, it is accessible to wheelchair users.
questions.translationJa: ショールームは改装工場にあります。広い通路で設計され、車いす利用者も利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: it＝showroomが設計された受動状態をDesigned with ...で背景化します。

questions.prompt: The contract arrived without the required signature. It cannot be processed without being ------- by both parties.
questions.translationJa: 契約書は必要な署名なしで届きました。双方に署名されなければ処理できません。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞withoutの後ろで受動動名詞being signedを作ります。

questions.prompt: The hotel stands beside the exhibition center. ------- within walking distance, it is popular with conference guests.
questions.translationJa: ホテルは展示場の隣にあります。徒歩圏内に位置するため、会議客に人気です。
questions.explanationJa: Locatedの意味上の主語it＝hotelが一致します。

questions.prompt: The caller was transferred four times. She complained about being ------- from one department to another.
questions.translationJa: 電話相手は4回転送されました。部署から部署へ回されたことに苦情を述べました。
questions.explanationJa: aboutの後ろに受動動名詞being passedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The samples arrived in sealed containers. ------- from direct sunlight, they remained stable.
questions.translationJa: サンプルは密封容器で届きました。直射日光から保護され、安定した状態でした。
questions.explanationJa: Protectedの意味上の主語they＝samplesが一致します。

questions.prompt: A customer complimented the support team publicly. Being ------- for their quick response improved morale.
questions.translationJa: 顧客がサポート班を公に称賛しました。迅速な対応を褒められたことで士気が上がりました。
questions.explanationJa: 出来事を主語にするBeing praisedが必要です。

questions.prompt: The invoice was sent to an outdated address. ------- by the client, it was returned to our office.
questions.translationJa: 請求書は古い住所へ送られました。顧客に受け取りを拒否され、当社へ返送されました。
questions.explanationJa: Rejectedの意味上の主語it＝invoiceで、受動背景を示します。

questions.prompt: Employees had no chance to review the announcement. They objected to being ------- at the last minute.
questions.translationJa: 従業員には発表を確認する時間がありませんでした。直前に知らされたことに反対しました。
questions.explanationJa: object toの後ろに受動動名詞being notifiedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The branch was renovated last month. ------- with brighter lighting, the lobby now feels more welcoming.
questions.translationJa: 支店は先月改装されました。明るい照明を備え、ロビーはより居心地よく感じられます。
questions.explanationJa: Equipped withの意味上の主語the lobbyが一致します。

questions.prompt: The applicant received three automated reminders. He was annoyed at being ------- so frequently.
questions.translationJa: 応募者は自動通知を3回受け取り、頻繁に連絡されたことにいら立ちました。
questions.explanationJa: atの後ろに受動動名詞being contactedを置きます。
